title: Icariin for Recovery of Tibial Dyschondroplasia in Chickens via BMP-2 Expression
author: Iqbal, Zhang, et al.
materials: GP tissue from each group was separated and homogenized using TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA) for the extraction of total RNA, which was transcribed into cDNA using a First-Strand cDNA synthesis kit (Tian Gen, China). Primers for BMP-2 were designed by using Primer Premier Software and were synthesized by Wuhan Qingke biotech. Co. Ltd. (Wuhan) based on the sequences published in GenBank database. The reaction mixture was normalized against the reference gene GAPDH. All the RT-qPCR reactions were performed in quadruplex using Step One-Plus™ RT-qPCR system (Applied Biosystems). RT-qPCR reaction system was composed of 10 μL SYBR reaction mix (Transgen Biotech) forward and reverse primers of a working concentration of 10 μL mol/L, 2 μL of cDNA and nuclease free water for a total volume of 20 μL. All the reactions were performed with the following thermal cycling parameters: 95 °C for 30 s (sec), 40 amplification cycles at 95 °C for 8 s, 59 °C for a time of 30 s and 70 °C for 30 s. Relative quantification was performed using delta (ΔCt) method [25].

steps.title: Decalcify and embed tibia samples
steps.instruction: Place tibial bone samples fixed in paraformaldehyde into 10 % EDTA for decalcification, then clear with xylene, embed in paraffin wax, and cut 4–5 µm sections for histology.

steps.title: Perform H&E staining
steps.instruction: Stain the 4–5 µm paraffin sections with hematoxylin and eosin according to the referenced method with slight modifications.

steps.title: Immunohistochemistry for BMP‑2
steps.instruction: Process the slides for BMP‑2 IHC: wash in PBS, block peroxidase (Boster), incubate with primary BMP‑2 antibody (1:2000, ABclonal) at 4 °C overnight, wash PBS, incubate with HRP‑conjugated anti‑rabbit secondary (Tuojie) at 37 °C for 1.5 h, wash, examine under Olympus CX31 microscope, and remove primary antibody from negative‑control slides.

steps.title: Quantify vascular area
steps.instruction: Capture images of the growth‑plate region and measure vascular area using Image‑Pro Plus software by assigning distinct colour codes to blood vessels and surrounding tissue.

steps.title: Extract RNA and synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Homogenize growth‑plate tissue in TRIzol (Invitrogen), isolate total RNA, and reverse‑transcribe  using a First‑Strand cDNA synthesis kit (Tian Gen) to obtain cDNA.

steps.title: Set up RT‑qPCR for BMP‑2
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µL qPCR mix containing 10 µL SYBR Green mix (Transgen Biotech), forward and reverse primers (working concentration 10 µL mol/L each), 2 µL cDNA, and nuclease‑free water; run on a Step One‑Plus™ system (Applied Biosystems) with the following program: 95 °C 30 s; 40 cycles of 95 °C 8 s, 59 °C 30 s, 70 °C 30 s. Analyze data using the ΔCt method, normalizing to GAPDH.

steps.title: Extract protein for Western blot
steps.instruction: Homogenize growth‑plate tissue in ice‑cold PBS, store at 4 °C for 2 h, centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 10 min, collect supernatant, determine protein concentration with a BCA kit (Service Biotechnology), and store extracts at –70 °C.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and transfer
steps.instruction: Separate 10 % of the protein samples on a 10 % SDS‑PAGE gel until the dye front reaches the gel bottom, then transfer proteins onto a PVDF membrane.

steps.title: Block and probe membrane
steps.instruction: Block the PVDF membrane in 5 % skimmed milk for 1.5 h at room temperature, incubate overnight at 4 °C with rabbit monoclonal anti‑BMP‑2 primary antibody (1:1000), wash with TBST (5 min per wash), incubate 30 min at room temperature with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody (1:3000), and wash TBST four times.

steps.title: Detect and image Western blot
steps.instruction: Develop the blot using appropriate chemiluminescent substrate and capture images with a UVP imaging system (Upland, CA, USA).
